_meta.scoring_methodology: Conservative hostile-validator sentiment classification: 'controversial budget discussion' is NEUTRAL; only material adverse events (DOJ/AG enforcement, layoffs >5% of staff, strike, civil grand jury rebuke, lawsuit cluster, receivership warning, hospital closure, fiscal crisis declaration) are NEGATIVE. Routine bond issuance / award / accreditation news is POSITIVE.
discipline_notes: Approximate trailing-12mo coverage counts — exact totals not enumerated where coverage is sparse; bracketed estimates given. Each NEGATIVE finding is backed by a cited article URL/date.

K-12 districts without independent fiscal-distress news but inside the broader 'CA school enrollment cliff' narrative are NOT marked negative — that narrative is sector-wide and already in CA-GO spread pricing.
Hospital obligors: news of nurse-strike or layoffs is sentiment-negative; news of CMS Care Compare star rating is captured by nh_cms_star_rating detector, not here.

summary.cross_vertical_pattern: CHFFA hospital sector dominates negative news activity: 3 of 4 hospital obligors fire under news-velocity screen vs. 0/2 water, 0/2 housing, 0/3 successor-RDA, 1/6 K-12. The hospital sector is exposed to (a) labor-action cycles (Stanford strike), (b) AG/regulatory enforcement (Providence Eureka abortion-care, Adventist HHS-OIG CMP + CA AG patient-disclosure), and (c) federal funding pressure (Lucile Packard layoffs tied to Medi-Cal cuts).
summary.etf_rebalancing_implications: Per hostile-validator + honesty-alpha framework: the 3 hospital fires are honestly disclosed and likely already reflected in CHFFA spread relative to State of California GO baseline; detector value here is exclusion-screen, not timing alpha. Recommend (a) excluding Stanford / Providence / Adventist from initial ETF launch basket pending price-impact confirmation, (b) keeping El Camino on watch with 90-day re-scan cadence, (c) leaving Clovis USD in basket but documenting Title IX litigation cluster as known contingent risk, (d) CalHFA + MWD + SD County as core anchor weights given affirmative positive rating actions in trailing 12 months.
